items.name: Barely Awake Boulder 2024
items.information: We are excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for the first time since 2016, and for the second ever 24+ hour competition held in North America! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need. https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww If this is your first competition, please be present 15 minutes before the competitor tutorial at 11:00 AM, which means you should plan to arrive at 10:45 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (2024-01-20 00:00 UTC)

items.name: Cubestuff Challenge Q1 2024
items.information: ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ## SPONSORSHIP A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ## VENUE HEAT This is an indoor venue with fans, but no aircon. It might get quite warm if we have a hot weekend. Please be aware of this, bring enough water, and make any preparations needed. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.name: Desafío Maipú NxN 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbGRmIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4ce819179ad510ec318e2923166dc018caa0ee86/A%C3%B1adir%20un%20subt%C3%ADtulo.png) **Español** El Desafío Maipú NxN 2024 es un emocionante torneo de cubos Rubik que promete ser un evento de vanguardia en el mundo de los rompecabezas tridimensionales. En esta competición, entusiastas del cubo se reunirán para poner a prueba sus habilidades resolviendo cubos NxN, desde los clásicos 3x3 hasta los desafiantes cubos NxN de dimensiones superiores. Este torneo representa la oportunidad perfecta para demostrar destreza, estrategia y rapidez en la resolución de estos enigmáticos acertijos. Con una combinación de competencia feroz y comunidad apasionada, el Desafío Maipú NxN 2024 sin duda será un evento imperdible en el calendario de los amantes del cubo Rubik. **English** The Maipú NxN Challenge 2024 is an exciting Rubik's Cube tournament that promises to be a cutting-edge event in the world of three-dimensional puzzles. In this competition, cube enthusiasts will gather to test their skills by solving NxN cubes, ranging from the classic 3x3 to the challenging higher-dimensional NxN cubes. This tournament represents the perfect opportunity to showcase dexterity, strategy, and speed in solving these enigmatic puzzles. With a combination of fierce competition and a passionate community, the Maipú NxN Challenge 2024 will undoubtedly be a must-attend event on the Rubik's Cube lovers' calendar.
